financial_anchor.caveat: Exact latest-period measure; period screen is not annualized unless period is full year.

ai_claim.claim: machine learning improves disruption handling, retailing and operational decisions
ai_claim.stage: E0/E1 mechanism hypothesis; named customer deployment unverified
ai_claim.limitation: No controlled company-wide cash bridge disclosed

strongest_counterevidence.claim: Public evidence lacks eligible-workload denominator, matched control, full cost and finance reconciliation.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Absence of disclosure does not prove absence of benefit

rights_limit: Access to customer, licensed, personal or partner data does not establish ownership or unrestricted cross-customer training rights. A defensible review must identify owner, permitted purpose, geography, retention/deletion, model-improvement permission and audit rights for each decisive dataset; public product access alone closes none of those questions.
materiality_summary: Five percent of 0.9432 EUR billion (H1 2026 IFRS operating income) is €47.16m for the half year. This is a period-consistent screen, not a forecast. This is not an annual 5% materiality hurdle; without a completed-year metric or explicit annualization it is NOT_COMPARABLE with annual benefit illustrations, and all earlier above/below comparisons are withdrawn.

arithmetic.inputs: 0.9432 EUR billion H1 2026 IFRS operating income; 5%
arithmetic.result: €47.16m for the half year; period-only scale, NOT_COMPARABLE to annual benefits

g2_provisional: Not passed: production availability is more visible than incremental causal economics. Product availability or management-described use supports E1/E2 only. G2 requires an eligible-workload denominator, frozen model/version, matched quality-adjusted comparator, full implementation and inference cost, and a reconciliation to recognized revenue, displaced spend, avoided hiring or released capital. Those elements were not found together in the public materials reviewed through the cutoff.
